_comment: Canonical branch-protection config for the `dev` branch. Authoritative source for scripts/branch-protection-apply.sh (follow-on per F-BRANCH-PROTECTION-DRIFT-WORKFLOW). Schema mirrors GitHub branch-protection REST API as of 2026-05-17.

required_status_checks._strict_rationale: Set to false per ADR-0124 to break the O(N^2) rebase cascade; the merge bridge enforces required status contexts without GitHub-side up-to-date enforcement.
required_status_checks._oya_pr_review_note: oya-pr-review is intentionally absent from Phase-1 required contexts. Its producer (reviewer-agent HTTP endpoint) returns HTTP 501 (not yet shipped); requiring it would deadlock every PR. Returns as required in Phase-2 once the reviewer-agent endpoint is live.

_required_pull_request_reviews_rationale: GitHub human approving reviews are not the merge authority for `dev`; the required `oya-pr-review` status/check is. Keep this null so branch-protection re-application cannot recreate the hidden requiresApprovingReviews=true/count=0 blocker that stalls the next queue.
